Evidence: whistleblower meeting, leaked emails, political warfare
#Aletheia #USPol

Federal prosecutors met with former Brooklyn prosecutor Daniel Wiesenfeld regarding instructions from his supervisor to target political allies.

The Poison:
The normalization of retaliatory investigations turns independent legal institutions into partisan battlegrounds.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (upholding law) with WHO (targeting political opponents). The system serves partisan factionalism rather than public justice.

Social Physics Analysis:
Institutions use procedural power to shield allies and attack rivals. Instead of resolving legal disputes transparently, actors deploy leaks and pretexts to maintain conflict.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When institutional integrity is traded for partisan warfare, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Institutional decay accelerates as public trust collapses.

The Unavoidable Truth: Accountability cannot function when law enforcement is co-opted for political retaliation.

The Unavoidable Lie: Both sides pretend their investigations are purely objective while weaponizing the process.
